original_card.acceptance_gate: An exact arbitrary-input identity, source/target frame availability and restoration at the chosen cut, plus the complete channel+correction+idle/hosting bill or an explicit favorable bound. actual_scope: Can a caller accept the PR3882 encoding (w, q, v_N) without restoring the original source slots and pass a dimension-scored replacement coverage law?
scope_change_reason: The card asks for a changed producer/consumer with a favorable full bill. Discussion comment 19030045 and open question 1 of research/p104-role-exchange-caller-audit ask only whether this one encoding can be consumed in place. This package answers that screen and stops. It does not rebuild the literal-slot, commutation, encoding, chart or fiber obstructions.
bottleneck_link: The source-consuming tail returns a different payload in the same frame-dimension multiset. If that multiset earns no new progress, the paired-chain moment stays above one and the tail is not a supplier. A payload-sensitive credit above 1544/9 would be a different law, not a scalar saving.
stop_rule: Stop when the in-place tail is shown to keep 104 full and 104 hyperplane data banks, to miss both caller payloads, and to need credit above 1544/9. Do not search schedules or propose a new coverage law in this package.
evidence: verify.py prints PASS_P104_SLOTFREE_COVERAGE. The tail has 208 rank-one conversions, M(0)=7785/7592 at credit 0, and the comparison is strict only for credit above 1544/9.
